newsitem.title: USA: J&L Specialty Steel anneal line operating.
newsitem.headline: J&L Specialty Steel anneal line operating.

text.p: J&L Specialty Steel Inc said Monday the Bright Anneal Line at its Louisville, Ohio, plant is fully operational.
Work on the $16 million project was completed in January.
"This facility continues to be the only one in the United States capable of processing highly desirable 48 inch wide Bright Anneal and Kool Line . product," said Gene Salvadore, J&L's President.
The upgrade of the line included a new furnace, brush scrubber and welder. The improvements to the line increase the company's capacity with significantly increased line speeds.

J&L said its Kool Line . product has received approval from the U.S. Department of Agriculture for use in dairy and other food processing applications that are surveyed and approved for USDA grading service. This product can now be found in Kitchen Aid's new stainless-lined dishwasher, as well as in a new line of stainless steel washers and dryers produced by Amana and Speed Queen.
